source_title: Cabinet minister Subodh Uniyal has apologised to Daler Mehndi after Uttarakhand event, reveals Mika Singh - The Times of India

Now Mika's team has revealed that Cabinet Minister Subodh Uniyal has issued an apology to the veteran singer.
